dct_description_sm: The sediment cores were collected to better constrain the submergence history of the east coast of Baffin Island. Through analysis of the stratigraphic record preserved in these cores and the dating of organic material contained within it, it is possible to determine when the sampled sedimentary features would have stopped developing due to submergence. The dates obtained from these cores are intended to complement dates retrieved from elevated shoreline features in order to provide the emergence history of the region.
dct_title_s: Marine sediment cores from submerged deltas and fjords of Cumberland Peninsula, 2014-2015
